description: team-sync: team summary at session start; commit + pull + push in the background after each turn

hooks.command: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$r/bin/team_sync.py" ] && python3 "$r/bin/team_sync.py" hook codex session_start || true
hooks.commandWindows: python3 -c "import os,subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip();p=os.path.join(r,'bin','team_sync.py');sys.exit(subprocess.call([sys.executable,p,'hook','codex','session_start']) if r and os.path.isfile(p) else 0)"

hooks.command: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$r/bin/team_sync.py" ] && python3 "$r/bin/team_sync.py" hook codex stop || true
hooks.commandWindows: python3 -c "import os,subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip();p=os.path.join(r,'bin','team_sync.py');sys.exit(subprocess.call([sys.executable,p,'hook','codex','stop']) if r and os.path.isfile(p) else 0)"
